en: A high-school senior gave a testimony before I preached,

text:
아이고 나 설교 안 해도 되겠다
그런 생각이 들었어요
en: and I thought, "I don't even need to preach."
I'd come to preach on our identity in the gospel,

text:
뭐 내가 설교 안 해도
다 되겠더라고
en: but the student had already said it all.
"Relationships were hard for me at boarding school
because I was trying to love people.
When I realized that God loves me,

text:
내가 누군가의 *눈치*를 보지 않고
사람을 사랑할 수 있게 됐다"
en: I could love people without worrying what anyone thinks."
